## Walkthrough

This PR fixes unsigned 32-bit integer handling across the codebase by correcting the `leBytesAsU32` function to properly normalize the assembled value with `>>> 0` before type casting, preventing sign-bit overflow. A similar fix is applied to `getStartPageIndex` bitwise alignment. Once these core functions correctly handle unsigned semantics, call sites in `hashToNumberSequence` and `generateNextServiceId` are simplified to rely directly on the corrected functions instead of redundant unsigned-coercion chains. Test coverage is added for both fixed functions.
